engineOverview.title: The Complete Guide to the Range Rover Evoque 204DTA Engine
paragraphs: The Range Rover Evoque 204DTA engine is a 2.0-litre, four-cylinder Ingenium diesel built by Jaguar Land Rover. It powers many Evoque models and also features in other Land Rover vehicles. Owners usually search for a replacement or repair after timing chain noise, turbo faults, oil dilution or major internal damage.

Ingenium engines share a family name but differ in output, emissions equipment and ancillaries, so matching the right unit matters. Before any Range Rover Evoque 2.0 diesel engine is supplied, we confirm compatibility using your VIN, the engine code stamped on the block and your registration details.

Whether you need a single repair or a full Range Rover Evoque 204DTA engine replacement, our team assesses the vehicle and explains your options clearly. Send us your registration or VIN, or call our team, and we will come back with a clear quotation.

engineProblems.title: Common 204DTA Engine Problems
engineProblems.description: Spotting early warning signs can stop minor faults turning into complete engine failure and higher repair bills.

cards.title: Timing Chain Rattle or Stretch
cards.description: A rattle on cold start or engine warning lights can point to a stretched timing chain, worn guides or a failing tensioner on the rear-mounted chain. We inspect chain stretch and assess internal wear.

cards.title: Rising Oil Level or Oil Dilution
cards.description: An oil level that rises between services may mean diesel is entering the sump, often linked to interrupted DPF regeneration on short journeys. We check oil condition and regeneration history.

cards.title: Turbocharger Faults and Boost Loss
cards.description: Loss of power, limp mode, whistling or blue smoke can indicate turbocharger wear, oil feed problems or a boost leak in the intake pipework. We test boost pressure and inspect the turbo.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: DPF Blockage Warnings
cards.description: Repeated DPF warnings, frequent regenerations or reduced performance usually show the diesel particulate filter is loading faster than it can clear. We read fault codes and assess the DPF.

cards.title: EGR and Coolant Problems
cards.description: Rough running, poor economy or unexplained coolant loss may relate to EGR valve or cooler faults, which can affect engine temperature and emissions. We inspect the EGR system and coolant circuit.

cards.title: Knocking or Low Oil Pressure
cards.description: A deep knock, a low oil pressure warning or metal particles in the oil often signal bearing wear and need attention before further driving. We assess whether a rebuild or replacement is required.

faq.description: These are common questions about the Range Rover Evoque 204DTA engine, from compatibility to warranty. If you cannot find your answer here, our team is happy to help.

faqs.q: How do I know a 204DTA engine fits my Evoque?
faqs.a: Send us your VIN or registration. We check the engine code, model year, transmission and drive layout against the replacement unit, because Ingenium variants can differ in ancillaries and emissions equipment even when the engine family looks the same.

faqs.q: Should I choose a used, reconditioned or rebuilt engine?
faqs.a: A used engine suits tighter budgets, a reconditioned engine has renewed wear parts and is ready to fit, and a rebuild keeps your original block. We recommend an option after assessing mileage, damage and your plans for the vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy the engine only and fit it elsewhere?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade customers and independent garages can buy supply only, with the engine prepared for collection or delivery. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians in Grays will complete the installation for you.

faqs.q: How much does a Range Rover Evoque 204DTA engine replacement cost?
faqs.a: The price depends on whether you choose a used, reconditioned or rebuilt engine, the extent of the damage, the ancillary parts required and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN and we will provide a clear written quotation.

faqs.q: What warranty comes with a replacement 204DTA engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option you choose and whether we carry out the fitting. We explain the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before any work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver engines across the UK or collect vehicles?
faqs.a: We supply engines across the United Kingdom from our workshop in Grays, Essex. Delivery arrangements and any associated costs are confirmed when we quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their vehicle to our workshop.

faqs.q: How long does a 204DTA engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: Timing depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is required and how much additional work the inspection reveals. We give you an expected timescale with your quote and keep you updated as the job progresses.

workshopIntro.title: Expert Advice Before You Choose an Engine
workshopIntro.description: The right choice depends on what has failed, the vehicle's mileage and value, and how long you plan to keep it. A contained fault, such as a stretched timing chain caught early, may only need repair. Where internal damage is severe, a rebuild or a Range Rover Evoque 204DTA engine replacement is often more practical.
paragraphs: Replacing the engine alone does not always solve the problem. Where relevant, we check the turbocharger, intercooler pipework, DPF, EGR system and cooling components, and renew the oil, filters and coolant, so contamination left in the old system does not damage the new engine.

To get started, send us your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain your options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery elsewhere in the UK.
